# Terraform GCP Pipeline Blueprint Module




This module provides a blueprint for setting up GCP pipeline resources, including IAM roles and service accounts tailored for different deployment targets like App Engine, Cloud Run, and GKE.


---

This project is part of our comprehensive approach towards DevOps Acceleration.

## Introduction

The GCP Pipeline Blueprint module is designed to streamline the creation of IAM roles and service account bindings necessary for CI/CD pipelines on Google Cloud Platform. It supports various compute services and ensures that the least privilege principle is applied by creating custom roles with specific permissions for deployment tasks.

## Usage


**IMPORTANT:** The `master` branch is used in `source` just as an example. In your code, do not pin to `master` because there may be breaking changes between releases.
Instead pin to the release tag (e.g. `?ref=vX.Y.Z`) of one of our [latest releases](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-gcp-pipeline-blueprint/releases).


To use this module in a Terragrunt configuration, you can include it in your `terragrunt.hcl` file. The module requires organization details and allows optional configuration for specific GCP services.

### Variable Structure (YAML)
```yaml
# Core Configuration
is_hub: false                     # (Optional) Is this a hub or spoke configuration? Default is false.
spoke_def: "001"                  # (Optional) Spoke ID Number, must be a 3 digit number. Default is "001".
org:
  organization_name: "myorg"      # (Required) The name of the organization.
  organization_unit: "myou"       # (Required) The name of the organization unit.
  environment_type: "dev"         # (Required) The type of the environment (e.g., dev, prod).
  environment_name: "myenv"       # (Required) The name of the environment.
extra_tags: {}                    # (Optional) Extra tags to add to the resources.

# Service Account Configuration
service_accounts:
  project_id: ""                   # (Optional) The project id where the service accounts are located. Default is the current project.
  preview_publisher: "gke-preview-publisher" # (Optional) The name of the preview publisher service account.
  terraform: "terraform-access"    # (Optional) The name of the terraform service account.
  build_publisher: "build-publisher" # (Optional) The name of the build publisher service account.

# Deployment Targets
appengine:
  enabled: false                   # (Optional) Enable App Engine configuration.
cloudrun:
  enabled: false                   # (Optional) Enable Cloud Run configuration.
gke:
  enabled: false                   # (Optional) Enable GKE configuration.
firebase_test_lab:
  enabled: false                   # (Optional) Enable Firebase Test Lab configuration.
firebase_test_lab_bucket_name: "" # (Optional) The name of the Firebase Test Lab bucket.
```

## Quick Start

1. Create a `terragrunt.hcl` file.
2. Reference this module as the source.
3. Provide the required `org` object in the `inputs` block.
4. Enable the desired deployment targets (e.g., `gke = { enabled = true }`).
5. Run `terragrunt apply`.


## Examples

### Terragrunt Example
```hcl
terraform {
  source = "git::https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-gcp-pipeline-blueprint.git?ref=v1.0.0"
}

inputs = {
  org = {
    organization_name = "cloudopsworks"
    organization_unit = "shared"
    environment_type  = "prod"
    environment_name  = "common"
  }
  gke = {
    enabled = true
  }
  service_accounts = {
    project_id = "my-gcp-project-id"
  }
}
```
